CharacterGenerator.NewCharacter.Title: New Character
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Intro.Title: How to Make Your Character
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Intro.Welcome: Welcome to Mothership®, the sci-fi horror RPG where you and your crew try to survive in the most inhospitable environment in the universe: outer space!
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Intro.Excavate: Excavate dangerous derelict spacecraft, explore strange unknown worlds, encounter hostile alien life, and escape the horrors encroaching upon your every move. Let's get started!
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Stats.Title: Roll Stats
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Stats.Instruction: Roll 2 ten-sided dice (2d10), add them together, then add 25. Record the results for each Stat.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Saves.Title: Roll Saves
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Saves.Instruction: Roll 2 ten-sided dice (2d10), add them together, then add 10. Record the results for each Save.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Class.Title: Choose Your Class
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Adjustments.Title: Class Adjustments
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Adjustments.Choose: It leaves one adjustment for you to place. Choose where it goes.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Health.Title: Roll Health
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Health.Instruction: Roll 1 ten-sided die (1d10) then add 10. Record the result for Maximum Health.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Health.Wounds: Characters can suffer a certain number of Wounds before they die. Each class has different starting Maximum Wounds. Characters gain a Wound when their Health reaches zero.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Skills.Title: Choose Skills
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Skills.Instruction: To choose a Skill you must have at least one prerequisite Skill (a Skill that has an arrow pointing from it) first.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Gear.Title: Roll Loadout, Trinket, and Patch
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Gear.Loadout: Roll for a Loadout based on your character's class.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Gear.Trinket: Roll for a Trinket and a Patch
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Gear.Credits: Finally, roll 2d10 and multiply it by 10 for starting Credits.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Gear.Reference: See Loadouts on pg. 7. Trinkets & Patches on pg. 8-9.
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Finish.Title: Finishing
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.Finish.Ready: Write the character's name and pronouns. Mark a zero above High Score. You're now ready to play your first session of Mothership!
CharacterGenerator.Wizard.RollRemaining: Roll the rest of this step

Mothership.YouRolled90OrHigher: You rolled 90 or higher, which is always considered a failure.
Mothership.StrengthSkillExample: Holding airlocks closed, carrying fallen comrades, climbing, pushing, jumping.
Mothership.SpeedSkillExample: Getting out of the cargo bay before the blast doors close, acting before someone (or something) else, running away.
Mothership.IntellectSkillExample: Recalling your training and experience under duress, thinking through difficult problems, inventing or fixing things.
Mothership.WhatARollTypeBuys: Advantage rolls twice and keeps the better result. Disadvantage keeps the worse.
Mothership.SanitySaveExample: Rationalize logical inconsistencies in the universe, make sense out of chaos, detect illusions and mimicry, cope with Stress.
Mothership.FearSaveExample: Maintain a level head while struggling with fear, loneliness, depression, and other emotional surges.
Mothership.BodySaveExample: Employ quick reflexes and resist hunger, disease, or organisms that might try and invade your insides.
Mothership.WhatGainingStressIs: You gain 1 Stress every time you fail a Stat Check or Save. Occasionally, certain locations or entities can automatically give you Stress from interacting with or witnessing them. Your Minimum Stress starts at 2, and the Maximum Stress you can have is 20. Any Stress you take over 20 instead reduces the most relevant Stat or Save by that amount.
Mothership.WhatRelievingStressIs: Occasionally, certain moments, places, or events can automatically relieve your stress. Escaping perilous situations, finding a serene location, or experiencing a touching moment with a loved one can have meaningful impacts on your mood and outlook on life. If your stress is getting close to 20, you should consider making a Rest Save - as the effects of a failed Panic Check can be devastating.
Mothership.WhatAWoundRollIs: Make a Wound Roll according to the type of Damage received.

Mothership.ItCanBeDestroyedLikeArmor: It can be destroyed, just like armor, whenever it is dealt Damage greater than or equal to its AP. Cover typically only protects against ranged attacks, but in some situations may help block a hand-to-hand attack.
